project.name: Silver Ridge Railway
project.character: Practical shortline, not tourist railroad tone
project.interchange_partner: Denver & Rio Grande Western (D&RGW). Original Class I partner since SRRX founding 1904. D&RGW founded 1870. Do not change or confuse this.
project.pvj_note: PVJ = Pine Valley Junction. Never 'Port Vance Junction' or any other expansion. Do not confuse or hallucinate alternate names.

locations.PVJ_industrial_spur: South side of PVJ, light blue on V8. Labeled "PVJ Depot and Intermodal" in V8 legend. Serves warehouse and passenger depot. Branches independently from mainline with NO connection to yard ladder.
locations.team_track_RIP: Gray track at south end of yard ladder. Passive/multipurpose. Absorbed into yard protection zone.
locations.mine_branch: Grade-intensive spur with switchback grades ascending to mine
locations.helper_pocket: Staging for helper engines on mine ascents. Part of PVJ yard protection zone.
locations.tunnel_bores: Two bores through the mountain. Part of north leg.
locations.gorge: East leg, south of the mountain
locations.southern_tunnel_portals: Boundary between north and south halves of layout
locations.smelter: Industry spur, part of mine run

geography.orientation: North leg = PVJ side through tunnels. South of mountain = Silver Ridge side, gorge, east leg.

rivers.pine_river: Runs through Pine Valley District and PVJ area. Named the valley (Pine Valley) before the railroad arrived.
rivers.elk_river: Runs through Silver Ridge District and gorge country. Drains the Elk River Valley. Replaces 'Silver Ridge River' everywhere.

geography.valley: Elk River Valley - the broader geographic region the SRRX operates in. Two river systems: Pine River (north/PVJ) and Elk River (south/Silver Ridge). The SRRX links two separate drainages across a mountain divide.

wiring_summary.command_station: CSB1 at 5A - single unit, no booster, no EB1s
wiring_summary.rule: Do not suggest EB1s or a second booster unless Jake raises the topic for reconsideration.
wiring_summary.protection: 1156 automotive bulbs - 9 zones. Bulbs in hand as of 2026-05-29.

fleet_summary.critical_obs: Obs2780 has NO rear coupler - permanent. Always PVJ end of Valley Flyer. F9A on Silver Ridge end.
fleet_summary.fleet_note: NO 40-Ton GE - it is a 44-Ton. Two switchers only: No.98 (70-Ton, DCC operational) and No.101 (44-Ton, stalls forward - axle swap diagnostic pending).
fleet_summary.valley_flyer_note: F9A may be DC-only - no decoder space found. White gear risk unresolved. Do not invest in decals or livery until settled.

acquisitions.notes: Entry-level. Painting structures. First targets: three Sears houses, Overton Coach kit. Applebee's and Chi-Chi's on hand as practice victims. Chi-Chi's repurposed as Federal Building. First airbrush test ~2026-05-25: mixed results. Thinner ratio too thin - ran like a wash, bled under tape. 1/8" masking tape insufficient for airbrushing - Tamiya low-tack tape needed. Technique fundamentals understood; calibration and materials adjustment needed. Sears houses will serve as practice progression.
PLA or resin kits with separate roofs. Silver Ridge residential. First major airbrush targets.

acquisitions.item: N Scale Architects #10051 Overton Coach Flag Stop Station
acquisitions.notes: Arrived. Includes attached privy. Gorge flagstop depot.

acquisitions.item: Dew Drop Inn N Scale Architects model
acquisitions.notes: Kit manufactured by Blair Line as 'Green Door Lounge' - that is the kit name only, not the layout history. On the SRRX it is and always has been the Dew Drop Inn.

250mm x 160mm print scale, ~25mm at N scale. Has trees/mountain/NPS arrowhead. No bison, no text beyond NPS. Plan: resin print + basswood posts + Sculptamold or carved foam stone base + decal for park name text. Font: Twentieth Century Condensed ~5.7pt at 75% horizontal scale. No taglines - too small.

Fault protection scheme for 9 wiring zones. Wired in series with isolated track sections. Self-resetting, illuminate to identify fault location. Install as each zone is wired rather than retrofitting later.
Primary use: holding 1156 bulbs. Secondary use: routing and organizing wiring under benchwork. Be deliberate about wire routing from the start.

acquisitions.item: Blair Line Dew Drop Inn kit (aka Green Door Lounge)
acquisitions.notes: Kit manufactured by Blair Line as 'Green Door Lounge' - that is the kit name only. Second copy ordered accidentally (Blair Line direct + Yankee Dabbler). Both being kept. Copy 1: Silver Ridge - Dew Drop Inn. Copy 2: PVJ - pub/diner, name TBD. Differentiation plan: different siding color, window/door trim color, signage and name. Narrative cover: sister businesses owned by same person or family - plausible for small mountain community entrepreneur. Buildings will be on opposite ends of layout with mountain between them.
Will serve as Silver Ridge passenger depot. Check footprint against Silver Ridge town loop geometry before benchwork commits placement.

acquisitions.item: Turn of the Century Town 3D model collection
acquisitions.contents: 9 shops, blacksmith, sheriff/jail, two banks, school, unnamed building, farmhouse, barn, general store, city hall. Kit format with separate parts (windows, pillars, fencing, second floors, roofs). Era-appropriate, consistent scale and aesthetic across the set.
acquisitions.notes: More buildings than Silver Ridge needs - overflow candidates for Pine Valley Junction. Kit format ideal for airbrush painting before assembly. Fine details (window mullions, porch pillars, fence pickets) may be fragile at N scale. Blacksmith fits Silver Ridge working-town character well. Cohesive single-designer set ensures consistent scale and aesthetic on street scenes.

app.persistence: Every edit auto-saves to localStorage. hydrate() validates roster and carStatus are arrays before trusting localStorage - discards and falls back to baked-in DB if not. Photo backfill in hydrate(): missing photo fields restored from file snapshot by record ID. Export Backup downloads timestamped HTML with current DB baked in between DB_START/DB_END markers. Reset clears localStorage and reverts to baked-in DB.
app.if_cards_missing: Hit Reset button first. Cause is stale/invalid localStorage from broken session.
critical: Do NOT remove <meta name='referrer' content='no-referrer'> from <head> - required for Google Drive thumbnail photos via file:// protocol
Edit tool truncates HTML file when appending large blocks to end - use Python write for tail changes
DB block wrapped with /*DB_START*/ and /*DB_END*/ markers
Never use browser Save As - strips script tags and corrupts file
History: Python refactor 2026-05-19 truncated file at line 1260. Restored from Export Backup 0904.
app.data_model: Road and number are separate fields (roster: road+num; carStatus: road+carNum). Numbers stored without # sign. Display layer constructs 'SP #5017'. Zones: id z1-z9 with name/coverage/boundary/bulb/fault/notes.
app.long_term: Single-file HTML + embedded JSON is functional hack. Right solution: separate DB as JSON with File System Access API (Chrome/Edge) or Google Drive API. Deferred.
